notes.title: Version 1.2.4 available!
notes.notes:
More and more players complete the Alien Shooter TD story line and ask us to diversify the process of replaying missions at higher difficulty.

We're happy to announce that now killing the final not only gives you satellite weapon but also lets you use all the troop classes at the same time!
Right after completing the final mission 7 soldier slots will appear in your inventory and all your army will be at your command.

Besides, the new version has a new achievement for killing the final boss and a lot of minor fixes and improvements.

Thanks for staying tuned!

notes.title: New in version 1.0.7:
New in version 1.0.7:
Sigma`s future plans.
notes.notes:
This announcement is not directly related to Alien Shooter TD. We placed it here because many of you are curious about our plans for near future, and in particular about the long-waited sequel of our most popular game...


Of course we remember about Alien Shooter 3, and we urge to make it - and play it - as much as you do! :) But right now economic situation won't let us make AS3 in the proper way. Meeting and even exceeding your expectations is the least we want. We believe AS3 as just an updated version of AS2 would bring no joy to all of us. So we'd better wait than rush and fail.


As you may have noticed, we work hard on our current projects, and we modify game engine, adding new graphic and gameplay features to it. All these efforts make us closer to the long-waited moment!


A word in your ear: in nearest future we're going to add network mode to all of our current projects. And this will be another big step to AS3.


Once we have your attention now, we'd like to hear your thoughts about Alien Shooter 3. Please write your comments about the way you want to see AS3, what's most important for you, what features must have highest priority during development. Your opinion is all-important! Thanks for being with us!
